web-guide-idea-75.audience: Home cooks keen to learn a particular regional dish.
web-guide-idea-75.offer: Run a cook-along with clear preparation and pauses. People pay for instruction and live troubleshooting rather than just the recipe text.
web-guide-idea-75.steps.0: Send ingredients, substitutions and prep steps early.
web-guide-idea-75.steps.1: Demonstrate each stage and allow cooking time.
web-guide-idea-75.steps.2: Check visible results and explain serving or storage for the recipe.
web-guide-idea-75.equipment: A phone on a stand and the normal equipment for the dish. No specialist camera is needed.
web-guide-idea-75.returnReason: Build a menu across separate classes, each teaching a new technique.
web-guide-idea-75.promotion: Show the finished dish and state how much advance preparation is required.

web-guide-idea-75.metadataDescription: Cook a particular dish together, sharing the ingredient list before the session. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
